raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 5, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the credits by assuming “songwriter(s)” means only lyricists and declaring Brian Green the “composer,” then erroneously conflated the credited producer/songwriter Brian Green with actor Brian Austin Green to chase his father, instead of recognizing Miley Cyrus (credited as Destiny Hope Cyrus) as a composer/co-writer whose father is Billy Ray Cyrus.
